sourceSelection: current-Main tracked plus nonignored untracked regular files under explicit inputRoots
testClassificationRules: *_test.dart in project test/ directories: explicit @TestOn(browser) selects browser, otherwise VM
apps/guardian/tool/*_test.dart are VM HTTP-fixture tests; not part of offline VM139 regression
test helpers and fixture Dart sources remain format targets but are not test entries

exclusionRules.description: Exclude ignored untracked generated/cache/local files as returned by git ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard; never read their content.
Only regular source files are hashed.

stabilityCheck: all selected files SHA256 re-read and input file set / HEAD rechecked before inventory write
